text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This race likely won't turn into a free-for-all brawl.
The only target in my sights—is Believe-san."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If I bring them down—victory is mine!
HYAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Durandal...
I have to find a way to counter this...
(Dadadadada!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Shoot!?
—While they were busy keeping each other in check, their openings were exploited, causing both Durandal and Believe to miss out on victory.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* That was a miscalculation...
To think she'd seize such a split-second opening. But...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A palpable sense of progress... It went just as I envisioned;
no, it was an even more meaningful race than I had hoped.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-san, Light O-san, my deepest thanks.
It's thanks to you two that I was able to run as well as I did today..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The unyielding pace they set revealed to me the exact moment to unleash the "Excalibur"...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: And thus, the sacred crest—was engraved within me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This mark will be the key to guiding me to victory in future sprints.
Even in races without the two of them."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Looks like... she's grasped something.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Speaking of grasping something, I have too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Huh, Light O-san, what are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
A hint for top speed. Durandal is fast.
Believe is too. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Add both their speeds together and don't divide by two—maximum speed!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Yes?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: So that I can run like that too. Well then, until we meet again.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Wait, Right O-san...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...And she's gone. We share a dorm room, so I know what an amazing Umamusume she is, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Her gaze is aimed entirely in the wrong direction.
I wonder if the day will ever come when we cross swords again?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder...

Calstone Light O
sprinted away in a straight line.
Thank you, Light O. Farewell, Light O.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, it went just as you anticipated.
By running alongside those two on a GⅠ stage...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The "Holy Sword" seems to shine even brighter now.
Enough to make an impact in sprint races as well.
choice_data_list: Yeah! That gives us a lot more options!
Yeah! This really broadens our options!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Yes. I am no longer an inexperienced knight.
As if blessing the two of them—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Durandal and Trainer!!
Today was amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! What an insane late burst!!
People called her the ruler of a small nation before,
but she's way beyond that level now!

Surrounded by a circle of passionate fans.
We were—right at the center of that round table.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I never expected such a warm reception...
It seems the "Holy Sword" has truly reached everyone's hearts.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you took a big gamble this time.
Yeah, because I took a big gamble this time.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Indeed. To have so many people who appreciate that courage...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please listen, everyone.
Just as you said, King <username>
is no longer the ruler of a small nation.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You are truly a fine king! To have pulled off
such a magnificent challenge!

Cheers far louder than ever before
echoed relentlessly into the evening sky.
A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono. A letter has arrived for us.
choice_data_list: By correspondence... do you mean fan letters?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, it is an official letter. It was properly sealed with wax,
and bore a signet ring impression as well.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Would you like to read it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, who on earth could it be from...?
Yeah. But who could it be from...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah――!
This is...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"To my dearest Knight Durandal,
and Trainer."

Good day. I am glad to see you are in good health as ever.
I watched your recent race.
And there...

"There was a side of you I never knew.
A splendid knight possessing dignity, manners,
and the courage to face any hardship."

"Seeing you after so long made my heart tremble with the desire to spar.
This time, not with swords, but in a race."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Having emerged from a season of hardship,
I have managed to claim many victories.
I pride myself on being a worthy opponent.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, O knight, O king of the neighboring realm.
I shall await you at the Mile Championship♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: From Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A letter from the Princess, Trainer-dono!
choice_data_list: So it came from Fine Motion...

text_block_list.text:
I have heard the rumors. While things stalled in the spring,
she has been on a winning streak ever since.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, it is an invitation from a benefactor—
what shall we do?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I would love to meet them too!
And offer my thanks once again.

And so, our next target race was decided.
An audience with the gracious princess.

At the 1600m GⅠ "Mile Championship" held in November,
let's show everyone how splendidly Durandal has grown.
